text: Vista Global Holding Limited is majority-owned by its founder and chairman Thomas Flohr; a USD 600 million investment agreed in March 2025 was a minority stake by a consortium led by RRJ Capital, with Andalusian Private Capital.
short: Thomas Flohr, Vista Global's founder and chairman, remains its majority owner after a March 2025 minority investment led by RRJ Capital.

source.name: ch-aviation – VistaJet secures $600mn private equity investment
source.quote: However, Flohr remains the majority owner even after the investment
source.note: The article identifies Dubai-based parent Vista Global Holding Limited and names the investors (RRJ Capital consortium, Andalusian Private Capital) as minority new shareholders.
